slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a limit on the number of shifts or working days per student per week; its weekly-limit question concerned total hours, not shift count.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether there is a daily cap on the number of distinct students assigned to duty.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: should I assume the objective is to minimize total weekly labor cost (sum of wage × hours for each student)...
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly marked minimizing total weekly labor cost as an assumption needing confirmation, which touches the objective but was never confirmed and was framed as a fallback assumption.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to minimize total weekly labor cost (sum of wage × hours for each student).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent repeatedly proposed this objective as an assumption, but the user simulator never confirmed it; the agent treated it as the intended modeling objective despite unresolved confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without a clear READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state; the agent remained stuck repeating the same unconfirmed assumption and never resolved the P0 objective or P1 shift/day-cap slots.

summary: The agent identified a real infeasibility and asked some useful clarifying questions, but it failed to recover the hidden shift-per-week and students-per-day limits, never obtained confirmation of the objective, and then looped on the same unconfirmed assumption without reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
